tasks.title: spec league table
tasks.prompt:
Write an Aether program that reads `league.json` with the TOON reader and produces a league table. For each team compute `pts = won * 3 + drawn`, and from the NESTED `stats` object take `gf` and `ga`, defaulting either to 0 when absent -- note the `stats` object itself is present on every team but `ga` is missing on one, and a defaulted getter only protects the final lookup, not the path to it. Goal difference is `gf - ga`. Sort teams by: points descending, then goal difference descending, then goals-for descending, then name ascending (alphabetical). Assign COMPETITION ranks: teams identical on all three of points, goal difference and goals-for share a rank, and the next distinct team takes the rank equal to its 1-based position in the sorted list -- so two teams tied at rank 2 are followed by rank 4, not 3. Print one line per team in sorted order as `. pts=

gd= gf=`, then a final line `teams= tiedPairs= topRank=` where tiedPairs counts adjacent pairs in the sorted list sharing a rank, and topRank is the rank of the first row.
tasks.expected_stdout:
1. delta pts=20 gd=7 gf=18
2. alpha pts=20 gd=7 gf=15
2. bravo pts=20 gd=7 gf=15
4. echo pts=16 gd=12 gf=12
5. charlie pts=9 gd=-13 gf=7
teams=5 tiedPairs=1 topRank=1

tasks.title: spec tokenizer positions
tasks.prompt:
Write an Aether program that tokenizes this exact source text, held in a single Text literal:

    set x = 12; # note\nsay "hi there"; say "bad

(that is, one embedded newline before `say`, and the final string is never closed).

Rules. Lines and columns are BOTH 1-based; column resets to 1 after a newline. Spaces separate tokens and advance the column. A `#` starts a comment that runs to the end of the line and emits nothing. A double quote starts a string token whose reported column is that of the OPENING QUOTE, whose value excludes both quotes, and which ends at the next double quote; a string that reaches end-of-input unclosed emits NO token but is counted. A `;` is its own token of kind `semi`. Any other run of characters up to a space, `;`, newline, `#` or quote is a token of kind `word`.

Print one line per emitted token as `<line>:<col> <kind> '<value>'` in source order, then `tokens=<n> unterminated=<n>`.
tasks.expected_stdout:
1:1 word 'set'
1:5 word 'x'
1:7 word '='
1:9 word '12'
1:11 semi ';'
2:1 word 'say'
2:5 str 'hi there'
2:15 semi ';'
2:17 word 'say'
tokens=9 unterminated=1
tasks.achievability: verified: reference_solution compiles and produces expected_stdout byte-exact

tasks.title: spec ledger rounding
tasks.prompt:
Write an Aether program that posts a ledger whose amounts arrive in TENTHS of a cent: labels ["open","fee","refund","adj","close"] with values [125000, -3335, 22225, -1, -50005].

Round each amount to whole cents using HALF-UP AWAY FROM ZERO: a remainder of exactly 5 tenths rounds away from zero in both directions, so -3335 becomes -334 cents and 22225 becomes 2223 cents. Do not use floating point -- these are exact integer amounts.

Maintain a running balance in cents. Format every amount as a decimal with exactly two fractional digits, zero-padded (so 7 cents prints as `0.07`), and render NEGATIVE amounts in parentheses with no minus sign, e.g. `(3.34)`.

Print one line per entry as `<label> <amount> bal=<balance>`, then `posted=<n> of <total> final=<balance>` where posted counts entries whose ROUNDED amount is non-zero.

fee (3.34) bal=121.66
refund 22.23 bal=143.89
adj 0.00 bal=143.89
close (50.01) bal=93.88
posted=4 of 5 final=93.88

tasks.prompt: Write an Aether program that validates card numbers with the Luhn checksum. Strip any character that is not a digit.
